mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (course_id, review_text, course_rating, instructor_rating, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{reviewText}, #{rating}, #{instructorRating}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.title AS title, c.description AS description, c.summary AS summary, u.nickname AS nickname FROM courses c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
